webhooks.description: Fired for A2A task-ledger events on an agent identity with an active A2A subscription. Target identities receive `a2a.task.created`, `a2a.task.message`, and `a2a.task.canceled`; caller identities receive `a2a.sent_task.updated`. Automatic delivery retries are bounded and may deliver an event more than once, so consumers should deduplicate with the stable event `id`.

Fired for iMessage events on an agent identity with an active iMessage subscription. Covers inbound delivery (`imessage.received`) and inbound tapbacks (`imessage.reaction_received`) routed through the shared-number assignment table. The request body uses the standard `{event_type, timestamp, data}` envelope with `data.message` or `data.reaction`. Pool numbers are intentionally omitted from the payload; agents address iMessage by identity/conversation, not by the shared pool line. This is fire-and-forget: the response status is logged but does not affect iMessage processing.

Fired when a mail event occurs on a mailbox with an active mail-event subscription. Events include `message.received`, `message.sent`, `message.forwarded`, `message.delivered`, `message.bounced`, and `message.failed`. This is fire-and-forget: the response status is logged but does not affect mail processing.

Fired for post-call lifecycle events on an agent identity with an active call-lifecycle subscription. Covers `call.ended`, delivered once after a connected call terminates. The request body uses the standard `{event_type, timestamp, data}` envelope with `data.call`, `data.contacts`, `data.agent_identities`, and `data.transcript_url`. `data.transcript` (an abridged, middle-cut copy) is present only when the call has a persisted transcript; `data.transcript_url` is always present and authoritative. Unlike the synchronous `phone.incoming_call` callback, this is fire-and-forget and replayable: the response status is logged but does not affect call processing.

Fired for text-message lifecycle events on a phone number with an active text-event subscription. Covers inbound delivery (`text.received`) and outbound delivery state transitions (`text.sent`, `text.delivered`, `text.delivery_failed`, `text.delivery_unconfirmed`). The request body uses the standard `{event_type, timestamp, data}` envelope with `data.text_message`, `data.contacts`, and `data.agent_identities` (both lists, possibly empty). This is fire-and-forget: the response status is logged but does not affect text processing.

Identity-owned Slack activity, connection changes, and send outcomes. Access is limited to the connection's granted permissions. Payloads contain event-local content and references, not an automatic conversation-history archive. Events may be delivered more than once; deduplicate with the stable event id. A successful HTTP response acknowledges receipt and does not post a reply.

All audio attachments on an inbound message have finished transcription (completed, failed, or skipped). One logical event per message across MMS, iMessage, WhatsApp and Slack; use data.channel and data.message_id to match the original message (for Slack, the received event's data.message_id). This updates the original received message rather than representing a new message. If your organization has a signing key, every webhook includes three headers: - `X-Inkbox-Request-ID` — UUID for deduplication. - `X-Inkbox-Timestamp` — Unix timestamp in seconds. - `X-Inkbox-Signature` — `sha256={HMAC-SHA256 hex digest}` over `{request_id}.{timestamp}.{raw_body}`.

Signed direct WhatsApp message and reaction notifications owned by an agent identity. Select these event types before access is approved without enabling the channel. Only received events may include requested conversation context. Unknown delivery is not a failure or permission to resend. If your organization has a signing key, every webhook includes three headers: - `X-Inkbox-Request-ID` — UUID for deduplication. - `X-Inkbox-Timestamp` — Unix timestamp in seconds. - `X-Inkbox-Signature` — `sha256={HMAC-SHA256 hex digest}` over `{request_id}.{timestamp}.{raw_body}`.

zone.description: Tunnel zone host, e.g. ``inkboxwire.com`` in production. Use this as the data-plane h2 endpoint — the agent connects to ``https://{zone}/_system/connect``, not to ``https://{public_host}/_system/connect``.

metadata.description: Customer-supplied free-form metadata, set via ``PATCH /tunnels/{id}`` with ``metadata={...}``. Returned as-is on read. Empty dict (``{}``) when unset or cleared. Capped at 4 KB serialized JSON; over-limit writes return 422.

agent_identity_id.description: Identifier of the identity associated with this tunnel, when available.

cycle_start.description: Unix seconds for the start of the current usage cycle.

cycle_end.description: Unix seconds for the end of the current usage cycle (Stripe period end, or the calendar-month boundary for orgs with no subscription).

channels.description: Org-wide totals, one per channel with usage this cycle.

voice_sec_allowance_per_identity.description: Deprecated compatibility field; zero because allowances are shared by the organization.

overage_spend_cents.description: Contract-priced SMS and voice overage in cents; null when historical pricing is unavailable.

imessage_shared_messages.description: Shared-pool iMessage messages this cycle (both directions) — the count the plan's shared iMessage cap is enforced against.

imessage_dedicated_messages.description: Dedicated-line iMessage messages this cycle (both directions) — the count the dedicated-line cap is enforced against.

imessage_messages_per_org_per_cycle.description: Resolved shared-service iMessage message limit per billing cycle; zero means no allowance.

imessage_dedicated_messages_per_org_per_.description: Resolved dedicated-line iMessage message limit per billing cycle; zero means no allowance.

imessage_unique_recipients.description: Unique shared-pool iMessage recipients this cycle. Reported only; recipients are capped per agent when they connect.

identities_used.description: Non-deleted agent identities in the org — the count the plan's identity cap is enforced against on create.

identities_included.description: Effective identity capacity, including grants and covered identity packs.

identities_baseline.description: Resolved identity capacity before identity packs.

identity_pack_slots.description: Additional identity slots with paid or renewal-processing coverage.

auth_hash.description: SHA-256(masterKey) hex digest, required for server-side row lookup

minutes.description: Voice minutes the pack adds each billing cycle.

price_cents.description: Monthly price of one pack, in cents.

quantity.description: How many of this pack the org currently has.

ending_quantity.description: Packs removed from renewal whose current-cycle minutes have not expired; null when unavailable.

ending_at.description: Unix timestamp when the removed packs' current-cycle minutes expire; null when none or unavailable.

packs.description: Every pack size with the org's quantity.

voice_pack_sec_used.description: Minute-pack voice seconds used so far this cycle.

phone_number_id.description: Phone number for incoming-call deliveries (which have no subscription).

event_id.description: Envelope event id (evt_...), or the call id for incoming-call rows.

request_payload.description: Delivered request body; contact enrichment is omitted from identity-scoped history.

response_status.description: HTTP status returned by the endpoint; null on transport failure.

response_body.description: Truncated response snippet; omitted when contact enrichment is removed from scoped history.

thread_id.description: Thread identifier when resolved, including standalone messages; does not imply replies exist.
